title: Combinatorial interpretations of Tutte polynomials at the point $(2,-1)$
summary: Let $G$ be a simple connected graph, and let $T_{G}(x,y)$ be the Tutte polynomial of $G$. Motivated by the works in \cite{Ma}, we, in this paper, introduce the even-left spanning forests of $G$ and odd $G$-partitionable permutations, and show that $T_{G}(2,-1)$ is equal to both the number of even-left spanning forests of $G$ and the number of odd $G$-partitionable permutations.
